mapper.select: SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ',') AS subjects, AVG(l.price) AS price, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lesson l ON tp.user_id = l.user_id AND l.status = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN subject s ON l.subject_id = s.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN language_field lf ON l.field_id = lf.id LEFT JOIN tutor_career tc ON tp.user_id = tc.user_id WHERE tp.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_auth WHERE auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR') GROUP BY tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img ORDER BY tp.rating_avg DESC, tp.review_count DESC

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ',') AS subjects, AVG(l.price) AS price, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lesson l ON tp.user_id = l.user_id AND l.status = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN subject s ON l.subject_id = s.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN language_field lf ON l.field_id = lf.id LEFT JOIN tutor_career tc ON tp.user_id = tc.user_id WHERE tp.id = #{userId} GROUP BY tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ',') AS subjects, AVG(l.price) AS price, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lesson l ON tp.user_id = l.user_id AND l.status = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN subject s ON l.subject_id = s.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN language_field lf ON l.field_id = lf.id LEFT JOIN tutor_career tc ON tp.user_id = tc.user_id WHERE tp.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_auth WHERE auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR') AND sg.name = #{subject} GROUP BY tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img ORDER BY tp.rating_avg DESC, tp.review_count DESC

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ',') AS subjects, AVG(l.price) AS price, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lesson l ON tp.user_id = l.user_id AND l.status = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN subject s ON l.subject_id = s.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN language_field lf ON l.field_id = lf.id LEFT JOIN tutor_career tc ON tp.user_id = tc.user_id WHERE tp.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_auth WHERE auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR') AND l.price >= #{minPrice} AND l.price <= #{maxPrice} GROUP BY tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img ORDER BY tp.rating_avg DESC, tp.review_count DESC

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ',') AS subjects, AVG(l.price) AS price, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lesson l ON tp.user_id = l.user_id AND l.status = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN subject s ON l.subject_id = s.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN language_field lf ON l.field_id = lf.id LEFT JOIN tutor_career tc ON tp.user_id = tc.user_id WHERE tp.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_auth WHERE auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR') AND (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%')) GROUP BY tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.rating_avg, tp.review_count, tp.profile_img ORDER BY tp.rating_avg DESC, tp.review_count DESC
